{{Top|leg}}
'''Crystadurium''' was discovered by [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] harvesters working on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. The [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] were found in [[Magma/Legends|lava]] flows and were originally thought to just be impurities.

However, researchers and [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] discovered crystadurium not only could withstand high heat and pressure, but it also was highly [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]-resistant. They worked with a design team from [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]] to create [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with shards of the material mixed with [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] alloy. The [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] ended before this armor could be used, and the plans were lost for decades.

A [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] librarian later rediscovered the plans and sold them to several arms manufacturers. It was heavier than normal armor and much more expensive.
